about: ebay_prices.py prices every game the feed mentions. 'games' are pinned: always tracked, even when nobody mentions them. For a pinned game, 'search' is optional (the words a listing must contain, when they differ from the title) and so is 'exclude' (listings containing any of these words are left out). 'never' lists titles that must not be priced, such as names the feed keeps matching by mistake. At most 100 pinned games. 'same_game' lists the names of one game that the library keeps as separate entries because it was released under another name (King's Field IV is The Ancient City in the US): the dashboard fills a site's missing price under one name from another name's figure for that site; nothing is searched differently. 'regional_names' lists games released in a region under another name: on that eBay site, a game whose name starts with 'from' is searched with 'to' in its place (Fatal Frame 2: Crimson Butterfly is Project Zero 2 on eBay UK).
